pr_title: roachtest: port multitenant/tpch to new roachprod API
pr_body:
The test is functionally mostly the same. One notable difference is
that we create tenants by name (not by ID). We also use the new APIs
to build a connection URL to the tenant directly.

Fixes: #117672.

Release note: None

review_comments:
More of an API nit than a nit for this PR, but it's not immediately obvious to me that `externalNodes` is optional in `c.StartServiceForVirtualCluster`. 

i.e., it's okay\not a mistake here to let `separateProcessNode` be empty since it defaults to starting the storage cluster instead.

Especially since storage cluster is optional, maybe external nodes should be an optional parameter too? Side note, but it also was not obvious to me that not passing in a storage cluster instead defaults to `c.All()`. That might just be a `makeNodes()` detail though.

100%. I've been using this API more recently to migrate existing tests and I had a similar feeling. `externalNodes` reflects the `--external-nodes` roachprod API, but in the command line we can choose to not pass that flag, and it changes whether we are creating an external process virtual cluster or not.

In the case of this roachtest API, it gets quite confusing. I was planning to open a quick PR to rename `option.TenantName` to `option.VirtualClusterName` for consistency. I'll also improve this API to make things clearer when I do that.
